set.body:
Scope: ScalaFIM plan/ADRs and public seams in locus4s, image4s, spatial4s, reframe4s, mesh4s.

Deliverable: Finalize the plan's unresolved provider homes using the actual consumers. Map old APIs to their single replacements and identify external callers. Reconcile related Mote work without reopening completed work.

Acceptance:
- Freeze the minimal external source-provenance home, neuroimaging declaration home and directional-transform boundary; preserve distinctions among lineage, ownership, identity and independence.
- Record mesh input classes currently accepted and explicit future refusal or raw/diagnostic routes.
- Ownership/deletion map covers moved symbols, private access, callers and persisted identifiers; dependency graph has no cycle. Only concrete reused capabilities move upstream.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U0: Settle ownership and the deletion map
